content.thinking:
Compiles cleanly even with -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wshadow -Werror. 

Now let me rebuild and re-run the entire test suite one more time to make sure the removal of push(char) didn't break anything, then run a broader randomized stress test.

Let me also add a few more randomized stress rounds with different FIB sizes (including 0, 1, 2 records) and trace sizes (0, 1, 2).

cd /work/tmp && ./errs.sh 2>&1 | tail -2 && ./stress.sh 500 560 0 5 2>&1|tail -2 && ./stress.sh 600 640 40 0 2>&1|tail -2 && ./stress.sh 700 760 3 3 2>&1|tail -2
